name: P4 Maintain records in a web table (demoqa.com) (Capture)
description: Delete the Legal department's records, add employees from a CSV through the table's pop-up form, search for one and raise the salary, and check the table. (Deletes come first: the demo site forgets records added in the same visit once one is deleted.) Web steps use captured objects (recorded with OOA Capture) instead of typed selectors where the element is fixed.

variables.name: folder
variables.description: Folder of these use cases, relative to the workspace (results go to its output folder).

variables.name: headless
variables.description: Run the browser without a window (for unattended runs).

variables.name: raise_for
variables.description: Last name of the employee whose salary is raised.

variables.name: salary_now
variables.description: Salary shown for the employee after the raise.
